faq.question: How are these rankings generated?
faq.answer: Rankings use deterministic EVSavari Score Engine signals from catalog data — range, charging, safety, value, and use-case scores. No LLM opinions or paid placement.

faq.question: Are prices final?
faq.answer: Ex-showroom prices are indicative from catalog data. Confirm on-road quotes with dealers in your city.
